description: Copy Hevy strength workouts into WHOOP Strength Trainer. Without from/to, takes the latest Hevy workout. Without write: true, only previews. With write: true, WRITES the workouts to WHOOP; workouts already in WHOOP are not written again. Reports exercises that have no entry in the exercise mapping.

from.description: First local date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the range. Requires to.

to.description: Last local date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the range, included. Requires from.

write.description: true writes to WHOOP; false or missing only previews.

name: hevy2whoop_sync
